messages.author: 363fe3263ccf9f6b
messages.subject: Syntax question: ggvis / dplyr inconsistency
parts:
Hi!

I have small question, which bugs me:

Given that dplyr and ggvis come from the same group of authors, why is it so that dplyr uses "a=b" notation in it's API's (mutate(a=b) for example) and ggvis uses "a=~b" notation (ggvis(x=~a, y=~b)). Is there some specific cause which I miss? Maybe there are some nuances that I don't understand about R.

Thanks!

-- 
Andrey Tatarinov
